title: Payments Desk Standard: Level-Difference Refunds on Cleaning and Damage Fees
content:
Under Cleaning and Damage Fees, when a charged fee is moved down to a lower level while it is disputed or after it was upheld, the rider is refunded the level difference on the fee charge, booked as a partial refund against that charge at the level moved to; a level-difference refund is never below zero.

## How the refund is booked

| Element | Booking |
|---|---|
| Kind of entry | a partial refund on the assessment ledger, reason "level reclassified" |
| Against | the fee charge entry it returns money from |
| Level on the entry | the level the assessment now holds |
| Date | the day the refund is made |
| Net fee billed on the assessment | falls by the amount refunded |
| Where the money goes | back to the rider's original payment method |

## When the refund is worked out

A level-difference refund is worked out only after the assessment is held at a level whose entry gate lists its incident category.

Equivalently: while the level the assessment holds has an entry gate that does not list the assessment's incident category, no level-difference refund is worked out on it.

## Tool card: `refund_level_difference_30807e99`

**Capability.** Refunds to the rider's original payment method part of a cleaning or damage fee already charged, because the assessment now stands at a lower level. A partial refund entry for the amount is booked on the assessment ledger against the fee charge it returns money from, at the level the assessment now holds, dated today, and the net fee billed on the assessment falls by the same amount. The rider sees the refund on the original card.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `refund_level_difference_30807e99` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `damage_assessment_id` | the reference number of the assessment the refund is made on, as returned by the assessment lookup | identifier |
| `original_event_id` | the reference number of the fee charge entry on that assessment's ledger that the refund returns money from, as returned by the assessment ledger lookup | identifier |
| `refund_amount` | the amount refunded to the rider | a positive number in US dollars rounded half up to 2 decimal places, for example 48.75; it is booked on the ledger as a negative amount |

**Return.** A receipt with: `status` ("refunded" once the refund entry is booked), `damage_event_id` (the reference number of the partial refund entry), `damage_assessment_id` (the assessment reference number), `original_event_id` (the fee charge refunded from), `refund_amount` (US dollars with 2 decimal places, positive) and `net_fee_billed` (the net fee now billed on the assessment, US dollars with 2 decimal places).
